run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-17T23:52:58Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers fires because the rule keys on Prometheus's own discovery count, max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 (for 10m), i.e. Prometheus found zero Alertmanagers, not that alert delivery failed. The Kubernetes listings I could read show no Alertmanager workload, Service or pod anywhere in the cluster: namespace prometheus holds only the operator, Prometheus, kube-state-metrics, headless prometheus-operated and node-exporter Services, its only StatefulSet is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (1/1 ready), and the cluster-wide Deployment (36) and Pod (66) listings contain no Alertmanager object, even though the alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com and alertmanagerconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com CRDs are installed and prometheus-operator is running 1/1 with no namespace-scoping arguments. The supported hypothesis is therefore that nothing is deployed for Prometheus to discover, leaving the discovery gauge at 0; that the Prometheus CR's alerting.alertmanagers setting and the generated config Secret could not be read, that an Alertmanager custom resource cannot be listed with these tools, and that the runtime logs came back empty keeps the conclusion partial. Separately, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was recreated at 2026-11-17T23:52:26Z under an unchanged StatefulSet revision (generation 1, currentRevision == updateRevision == ...-677d847d59) with restartCount 0, which is a change I cannot attribute: no events are stored for that period. All five nodes were Ready and unchanged, so node churn is not the explanation. The alert payload's start time of 23:52:58Z is consistent with the 10m 'for' clause having been satisfied by an earlier instance, which would mean the zero-alertmanager condition predates the pod recreation, but the metric itself is absent from the queryable metric source.

claims.text: The PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule in ConfigMap prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 is `max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1` with `for: 10m` and severity warning; it therefore fires on zero discovered Alertmanagers, not on failed notification sends (those are covered by separate PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers and PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager rules).

The Alertmanager APIs are installed in the cluster: CRDs alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com and alertmanagerconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com exist alongside prometheuses.monitoring.coreos.com, so the operator is capable of reconciling an Alertmanager.

The prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator Deployment is running and ready (1/1) and its container args contain only kubelet-service, config-reloader, thanos and TLS-web flags (no --namespaces restriction), i.e. it is not scoped away from the prometheus namespace.

The Services returned for namespace prometheus are exactly prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (port 9090 http-web, port 8080 reloader-web), prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated (headless) and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter; the listing contains no Alertmanager Service (an Alertmanager would normally be exposed on port 9093).

Namespace prometheus contains exactly one StatefulSet, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, with 1 desired and 1 available replica; no Alertmanager StatefulSet appears in the returned listing.
The cluster-wide Deployment listing (36 objects returned, not truncated) includes prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator and prometheus-kube-state-metrics but no Alertmanager workload.

The cluster-wide Pod listing (66 objects returned) contains no Alertmanager pod, while it does contain prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0, phase Running, podIP 100.96.5.74, startTime 2026-11-17T23:52:26Z, containers config-reloader and prometheus both ready with restartCount 0 and container startedAt 2026-11-17T23:52:27Z.

The StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus has metadata.generation 1, observedGeneration 1, and currentRevision equal to updateRevision equal to prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59, and pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 carries controller-revision-hash prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59, so the pod was created at 23:52:26Z under an unchanged pod template (no rollout revision change) and was not a container restart.
All five nodes are Ready (Ready condition True, last transition 2026-11-13 to 2026-11-14) and none is unschedulable, so node failure or replacement around the incident window is not visible.

The events that are stored for the authorized window cover only 2026-11-18T00:00:18Z to 00:33:04Z and group to involvedObject kinds Deployment, Job, PersistentVolume, PersistentVolumeClaim, Pod, ReplicaSet and StatefulSet in namespaces data-recorders and otel-demo only; the grouped view contains no event whose involvedObject.namespace is prometheus.

The queryable metric source only carries the job label values kube-state-metrics, kubelet and otel-collector; no series with job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus" are present, so the Prometheus self-scrape that produces prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is not in this data source.

Most likely explanation: no Alertmanager instance is deployed in this cluster, so Prometheus's Alertmanager service discovery yields zero targets and prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered stays at 0, satisfying the < 1 rule condition; every listing I could read (Services in prometheus, StatefulSet in prometheus, cluster-wide Deployments and Pods) returned no Alertmanager object, while the Alertmanager CRDs and a cluster-wide prometheus-operator are present.

The condition likely began at or before about 2026-11-17T23:42:58Z rather than at the 23:52:26Z pod recreation: the rule requires 10 minutes of max_over_time(discovered) < 1 before firing, and the alert's own start time is 23:52:58Z, which would only be reachable if the previous Prometheus instance was already reporting 0 discovered Alertmanagers. This rests on the alert payload's timestamp, which I could not corroborate because the metric is absent from the queryable data source.

An Alertmanager could in principle exist as an Alpha CR whose StatefulSet and Service the operator has not produced (reconcile failure), which would equally leave discovery at zero; the 1/1 readiness of prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator shows it is running, but its logs were unreadable, so this alternative cannot be excluded.

A network block between Prometheus and Alertmanager is not an explanation for this specific alert: the firing expression is a discovery-count test on prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered < 1, so traffic being refused would surface as PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers or PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager (rate of prometheus_notifications_errors_total against prometheus_notifications_sent_total), not as zero discovered Alertmanagers.

Prometheus itself is up and ready rather than crashing: the StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus reports 1/1 ready, the pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running on node i-0bc0544469bfef13a with both containers ready and restartCount 0, and no previous container instance exists for the prometheus or config-reloader containers, so the alert is not explained by Prometheus being down or crash-looping.

Verify the alerting side of the Prometheus object: read spec.alerting.alertmanagers on the Prometheus CR prometheus/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus and the generated config Secret, and query the Prometheus API endpoint /api/v1/alertmanagers to see whether any endpoint is listed.

Confirm whether an Alertmanager CR (monitoring.coreos.com/v1) is expected at all: if alert delivery is intended, apply or restore an Alertmanager so its StatefulSet, Service and port-9093 Endpoints exist and are referenced by the Prometheus alerting config; if not, suppress or re-tune the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule so an intentionally absent Alertmanager does not page.

Separately from the alert, find out why prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was recreated at 2026-11-17T23:52:26Z under an unchanged StatefulSet revision: inspect kubelet and audit history around 23:52, since cluster events before 2026-11-18T00:00:18Z are not retained in the readable store.

gaps: The metric prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered itself is not available: the queryable Prometheus exposes only job values kube-state-metrics, kubelet and otel-collector, and queries for metric names matching {__name__=~"prometheus_.*"} returned no data, so the value at the incident and whether it is still below 1 at 2026-11-18T00:42:37Z is unverified.

The Prometheus custom resource spec.alerting.alertmanagers and the operator-generated Prometheus config Secret could not be read (secrets are not readable and custom resource kinds are not exposed by these tools), so whether the alerting config is empty or names a non-existent Alertmanager Service is unknown.
Whether an Alertmanager custom resource exists, or existed and was deleted, could not be determined, because the tools cannot list custom resources; only the CRDs themselves were readable.

Application and operator logs are unavailable in this environment: fetch_pod_logs returned 0 bytes for prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 (all three containers), for prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh and for otel-demo/frontend-675fd7b5c5-2psc4, so Prometheus's Alertmanager discovery errors and the operator's reconcile messages are unknown.

The reason for the 2026-11-17T23:52:26Z recreation of pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is unknown: the event store only holds events from 2026-11-18T00:00:18Z onward and the change_history integration is not available, so no SuccessfulDelete/SuccessfulCreate or kubelet action is visible.
A query of NetworkPolicies returned no data and cannot support a statement either way; whether any network policy exists in the cluster is unchecked in citable form.
No evidence was obtained about downstream or customer impact of this alert, and none is claimed.
next_steps: Read the Prometheus CR (kubectl get prometheus prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus -n prometheus -o yaml) and check spec.alerting.alertmanagers, then check the generated config Secret for the alerting section.

If an Alertmanager is expected, look for an Alertmanager CR in all namespaces and for a missing Service or Endpoints on port 9093, and check prometheus-operator reconcile errors around 2026-11-17T23:52Z.

Query the Prometheus instance directly at 100.96.5.74:9090 via /api/v1/alertmanagers and the prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered expression to obtain the value the alert rule is acting on.

If alerting is intentionally not configured in this cluster, classify this alert as expected noise and adjust the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule or its Alertmanager reference rather than treating it as an outage.

view.cannot_prove: Only what the containers wrote to standard output and standard error and the node still keeps: the current instance and the one before it, nothing older and nothing from a pod that no longer exists. No matching line is not proof that something did not happen; lines cut by limit or by the read limit, and lines not read, are unknown, not absent.

Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.

content:
groups:
- name: prometheus
  rules:
  - alert: PrometheusBadConfig
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        reload its configuration.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusbadconfig
      summary: Failed Prometheus configuration reload.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_config_last_reload_successful{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) == 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusSDRefreshFailure
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        refresh SD with mechanism {{$labels.mechanism}}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheussdrefreshfailure
      summary: Failed Prometheus SD refresh.
    expr: increase(prometheus_sd_refresh_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[10m])
      > 0
    for: 20m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusKubernetesListWatchFailures
    annotations:
      description: Kubernetes service discovery of Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        is experiencing {{ printf "%.0f" $value }} failures with LIST/WATCH requests
        to the Kubernetes API in the last 5 minutes.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuskuberneteslistwatchfailures
      summary: Requests in Kubernetes SD are failing.
    expr: increase(prometheus_sd_kubernetes_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotificationQueueRunningFull
    annotations:
      description: Alert notification queue of Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        is running full.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotificationqueuerunningfull
      summary: Prometheus alert notification queue predicted to run full in less than
        30m.
    expr: |-
      # Without min_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        predict_linear(prometheus_notifications_queue_length{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m], 60 * 30)
      >
        min_over_time(prometheus_notifications_queue_capacity{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% of alerts sent by Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        to Alertmanager {{$labels.alertmanager}} were affected by errors.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuserrorsendingalertstosomealertmanagers
      summary: More than 1% of alerts sent by Prometheus to a specific Alertmanager
        were affected by errors.
    expr: |-
      (
        rate(prometheus_notifications_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      /
        rate(prometheus_notifications_sent_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
      * 100
      > 1
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not connected
        to any Alertmanagers.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers
      summary: Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBReloadsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
        | humanize}} reload failures over the last 3h.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustsdbreloadsfailing
      summary: Prometheus has issues reloading blocks from disk.
    expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_reloads_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[3h])
      > 0
    for: 4h
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBCompactionsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
        | humanize}} compaction failures over the last 3h.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustsdbcompactionsfailing
      summary: Prometheus has issues compacting blocks.
    expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_compactions_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[3h])
      > 0
    for: 4h
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotIngestingSamples
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not ingesting
        samples.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotingestingsamples
      summary: Prometheus is not ingesting samples.
    expr: |-
      (
        sum without(type) (rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])) <= 0
      and
        (
          sum without(scrape_job) (prometheus_target_metadata_cache_entries{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}) > 0
        or
          sum without(rule_group) (prometheus_rule_group_rules{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}) > 0
        )
      )
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusDuplicateTimestamps
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is dropping {{
        printf "%.4g" $value  }} samples/s with different values but duplicated timestamp.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusduplicatetimestamps
      summary: Prometheus is dropping samples with duplicate timestamps.
    expr: rate(prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_duplicate_timestamp_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOutOfOrderTimestamps
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is dropping {{
        printf "%.4g" $value  }} samples/s with timestamps arriving out of order.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusoutofordertimestamps
      summary: Prometheus drops samples with out-of-order timestamps.
    expr: rate(prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_out_of_order_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} failed to send
        {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% of the samples to {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{
        $labels.url }}
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotestoragefailures
      summary: Prometheus fails to send samples to remote storage.
    expr: |-
      (
        (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_failed_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
      /
        (
          (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_failed_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
        +
          (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_succeeded_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
        )
      )
      * 100
      > 1
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteWriteBehind
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} remote write is
        {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}s behind for {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{ $labels.url
        }}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotewritebehind
      summary: Prometheus remote write is behind.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      -
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
      > 120
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteWriteDesiredShards
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} remote write desired
        shards calculation wants to run {{ $value }} shards for queue {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{
        $labels.url }}, which is more than the max of {{ printf `prometheus_remote_storage_shards_max{instance="%s",job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}`
        $labels.instance | query | first | value }}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotewritedesiredshards
      summary: Prometheus remote write desired shards calculation wants to run more
        than configured max shards.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_shards_desired{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      >
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_shards_max{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusRuleFailures
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        evaluate {{ printf "%.0f" $value }} rules in the last 5m.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusrulefailures
      summary: Prometheus is failing rule evaluations.
    expr: increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusMissingRuleEvaluations
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has missed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} rule group evaluations in the last 5m.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusmissingruleevaluations
      summary: Prometheus is missing rule evaluations due to slow rule group evaluation.
    expr: increase(prometheus_rule_group_iterations_missed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTargetLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has dropped {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} targets because the number of targets exceeded the
        configured target_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustargetlimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped targets because some scrape configs have exceeded
        the targets limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_exceeded_target_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusLabelLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has dropped {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} targets because some samples exceeded the configured
        label_limit, label_name_length_limit or label_value_length_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuslabellimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped targets because some scrape configs have exceeded
        the labels limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_exceeded_label_limits_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusScrapeBodySizeLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} scrapes in the last 5m because some targets exceeded
        the configured body_size_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusscrapebodysizelimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped some targets that exceeded body size limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrapes_exceeded_body_size_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusScrapeSampleLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} scrapes in the last 5m because some targets exceeded
        the configured sample_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusscrapesamplelimithit
      summary: Prometheus has failed scrapes that have exceeded the configured sample
        limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrapes_exceeded_sample_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTargetSyncFailure
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.0f" $value }} targets in Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        have failed to sync because invalid configuration was supplied.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustargetsyncfailure
      summary: Prometheus has failed to sync targets.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_sync_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[30m])
      > 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusHighQueryLoad
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} query API has
        less than 20% available capacity in its query engine for the last 15 minutes.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheushighqueryload
      summary: Prometheus is reaching its maximum capacity serving concurrent requests.
    expr: avg_over_time(prometheus_engine_queries{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      / max_over_time(prometheus_engine_queries_concurrent_max{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0.8
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% minimum errors while sending alerts
        from Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} to any Alertmanager.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuserrorsendingalertstoanyalertmanager
      summary: Prometheus encounters more than 3% errors sending alerts to any Alertmanager.
    expr: |-
      min without (alertmanager) (
        rate(prometheus_notifications_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus",alertmanager!~``}[5m])
      /
        rate(prometheus_notifications_sent_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus",alertmanager!~``}[5m])
      )
      * 100
      > 3
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
